params.message:
The list becomes Contacts, beside the Newsletter, and a contact can get no newsletter

The people on the list are more than newsletter readers: supporters, partners and possible
sponsors are kept there too. So the menu gets Contacts, the list itself, and Newsletter,
the newsletters being written; both open for whoever may open the newsletter section, and
the right is now called Contacts and newsletter. /newsletter-admin leads to /contacts.

On Contacts the list has the page. Adding one contact, importing and the download to send
are behind three buttons on top, one open at a time. The counts show how many get each
newsletter, per language, and how many get none.

A contact can get no newsletter (NONE): a possible sponsor who never asked for one. They are
in no download to send, only in the backup. If they later sign up on a website they get a
confirmation mail like anyone new, so nobody can sign up a known contact. A sign-up form
cannot ask for no newsletter.
